Eden: Quick update — two HUGE things: I just got promoted to Senior PM and Jess and I are expecting a baby (due Aug)! :tada: :baby: 
Priya: WHAT!! 🙌🙌🙌 Congrats x1000. Drinks + cake at the office? 
Mira: omg congrats Eden!!! when's the last day you're still taking meetings so we can plan a proper celebration? 
Eden: still around, not changing calendars yet. thinking a small sprinkle during lunch the week of 8/10, but open to a weekend get-together too. will confirm dates soon. 
Kai: massive congrats. I can help organize. Food poll idea: dumplings or hand pies? 🥟🥧 
Lucas: hand pies for the win. I will bring my infamous spinach & feta batch (warning: wildly addictive). 
Ayesha: dumplings! also can we do a "bring-your-baby-swag" desk decor thing? 😂 
EventsBot: Heads-up — please submit an events request so we can reserve the downstairs kitchen and catering budget: https://company.internal/events-request 
Sana: Hi all — I can reserve the downstairs kitchen for 8/12 lunch and add a small catering budget. Eden, if that date works I'll block it and follow up with vendor options. 
Eden: That would be amazing, @Sana — thank you!! Really appreciate everyone. ❤️
